patterns: Dominant shape: 'Which is NOT a constitutional body?' with Planning Commission / NITI Aayog / NDC as the odd one out.
APPSC asks counts and odd-one-out (only Art. 350B officer constitutional among NITI, NCM, NHRC; NITI odd among NCBC, CAG, FC) and Inter-State Council as the constitutional inter-state body.
Recurring facts: FC report laid by President (Art. 281), UPSC report to President, NDC formed 6 Aug 1952, State Finance Commission constituted by Governor.
Firsts: K.C. Neogy (FC), Nehru (Planning Commission), Panagariya (NITI VC), M.C. Setalvad (Law Commission), B.G. Kher (Official Language Commission).
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement and match-the-list items with peripheral trivia (order of precedence, NCM composition) than the direct PYQ style.
